_comment: Merged into ~/.claude/settings.json by core/env/apply.py, key by key. Auto permission mode, and the status line that shows the cwd and a frozen tab.

statusLine.command: f={{BENCH_DIR}}/core/tools/freeze/statusline.sh; if [ -f "$f" ]; then bash "$f"; else printf '\033[34m%s\033[0m' "$(jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd')"; fi
